question.text: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)
question.resolution_criteria:
Each subquestion will resolve as the diluted earnings per share (EPS) in conformity with US generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) reported in each company's first official quarterly earnings release after September 30, 2026. This is expected to be released no earlier than:

* Apple Q4 FY2026 November 2, 2026 ([source](https://finance.yahoo.com/calendar/earnings?symbol=AAPL))
* AMD Q3 FY2026 November 3, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMD/earnings))
* Amazon Q3 FY2026 October 29, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMZN/earnings))
* Meta Q3 FY2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/META/earnings))
* Microsoft Q1 FY2027 October 28, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/MSFT/earnings))
* Nvidia Q3 FY 2027 November 25, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/NVDA/earnings))
* SpaceX Q3 FY 2026 October 20, 2026 ([source](https://www.wallstreethorizon.com/spacex-earnings-calendar))
* Tesla Q3 FY 2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TSLA/earnings))

The earnings reports are typically released on the respective companies' investor relations websites and filed with the [U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/search-filings) as a Form 8-K.
question.fine_print:
Only the initially reported figures encompassing the entirety of the quarter will be considered. Any subsequent revisions, corrections, or restatements will not affect resolution. 

If a company does not publicly report earnings after September 30, 2026 and before January 1, 2027 or if it ceases to operate as a standalone public company, that specific subquestion will be **annulled**.

## 1. Resolution source
- **2026-11-03 (scheduled):** AMD reports Q3 FY2026 after the market close, with the call at 5:00 PM ET. The resolving figure is GAAP diluted EPS in that release, at ir.amd.com and in the SEC Form 8-K. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-3-advanced-micro-devices-inc-stock/)
- **2026-08-04, latest reported quarter (Q2 2026):** GAAP diluted EPS was **$1.38** and non-GAAP was $1.66. Revenue was $11.54B, GAAP net income $2,297M, on 1,659M diluted shares. [AMD IR](https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1295/amd-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results), [SEC 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000002488/000000248826000121/q22026991.htm)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The release comes about 10 hours after forecasts close.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

Its own history is inconsistent: it lists Q2 2026 at $1.04 against the reported $1.38, so treat it with caution. [Hudson Labs](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/amd-q3-2026-earnings-preview-revenue-guidance-key-drivers)
- **2026-08-04:** Q3 guidance is revenue of about $13.0B ± $0.3B with non-GAAP gross margin around 56%. The non-GAAP tax rate is 13%. [AMD IR](https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1295/amd-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results)

## 4. Base rates
**GAAP vs non-GAAP diluted EPS by quarter:**

| Quarter | GAAP | Non-GAAP | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q2 2025 | $0.54 | - | - |
| Q3 2025 | $0.75 | $1.20 | $0.45 |
| Q4 2025 | $0.92 | $1.53 | $0.61 |
| Q1 2026 | $0.84 | $1.37 | $0.53 |
| Q2 2026 | $1.38 | $1.66 | $0.28 |

- The Q2 2025 figure reflects $800M of MI308 export-control charges, offset in part by an $853M tax benefit. The Q3 2025 figure is from memory of the Q3 2025 release and should be checked. [AMD Q4'25](https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1276/amd-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial-results), [AMD Q1'26](https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1284/amd-reports-first-quarter-2026-financial-results)

**Why Q2 2026's gap was small.** It included a one-off **$483M net gain on long-term investments**; the comparable gain was $66M in Q1 2026. The other Q2 reconciling items were:
- stock-based compensation: $503M
- amortization of acquired intangibles: $544M
- acquisition and other costs: $41M
- a $17M legal loss contingency
- a tax adjustment of -$161M

Without the gain, Q2 GAAP EPS would have been about $1.10-1.15. That is my own arithmetic, not a reported number.

**Rough arithmetic for Q3 (not a forecast):**
- At $1.94 non-GAAP on about 1.66-1.67B shares, non-GAAP net income is about $3.2B.
- Applying Q2-sized recurring adjustments (about $1.1B pre-tax, partly offset by about $0.15B of tax effect) gives GAAP net income of about $2.25-2.3B.
- That works out to roughly **$1.35-1.40 GAAP EPS** before any investment gain or loss.
- Investment marks, tax items or charges have moved GAAP EPS by about ±$0.30 in single quarters.

**Beat history:** Non-GAAP results have met or beaten consensus in each of the last 8 quarters. The beats were typically $0.00-0.21; Q4 2025, for example, came in at $1.53, $0.21 above estimates. [AlphaQuery](https://www.alphaquery.com/stock/AMD/earnings-history)

## 5. Other forecasts
- **Polymarket**, "Will AMD beat quarterly earnings?" (as of 2026-10-28): Yes at 0.75. This refers to beating the non-GAAP consensus, so it's only indirectly relevant.
- **Kalshi:** only earnings-call mention markets exist, for example "China" at 0.84 and "Export Restriction" at 0.48. None are about EPS.
- **Analyst GAAP consensus:** I couldn't find a reliable one. The only figure is the questionable Hudson Labs $1.42.
- **Manifold / Metaculus:** I found nothing that matches this question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **2026-10-28 and 2026-10-29:** The Fed decision and Intel's Q3 report (Oct 29) could move chip sentiment, but neither changes AMD's already-closed quarter. [Zacks](https://www.zacks.com/stock/news/3016129/can-slightly-higher-processor-revenues-aid-intel-s-q3-earnings)
- **2026-11-03, after close:** AMD's release. The main swing factors for GAAP versus non-GAAP are:
  - gains or losses on long-term investments
  - export-control inventory charges, if any
  - tax items
  - any acquisition-related costs
  - the size of stock-based compensation
- I found no pre-announcement or 8-K from AMD about Q3 charges or gains.

- That reduces non-GAAP net income by about $0.95B, or roughly $0.57 per share.
- On a non-GAAP base of $1.94, that implies GAAP EPS of about $1.37-1.40.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** AMD has met or beaten non-GAAP consensus in each of the last 8 quarters, so actual non-GAAP is likely around $1.98-2.05. That implies GAAP of about $1.42-1.48, before any investment marks or one-off items.

(e) **Historical variation:** The quarterly GAAP-to-non-GAAP gap has ranged from $0.28 to $0.61. Investment marks, tax items and charges have moved GAAP EPS by about ±$0.30 in single quarters.

(f) **Expert and market expectations:**
- Non-GAAP consensus is $1.93-1.94.
- Polymarket prices a 75% chance of beating that non-GAAP consensus.
- The only GAAP consensus found is Hudson Labs at $1.42, and its history is unreliable.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** Charges from the OpenAI warrant tranches vesting, recorded as contra-revenue or expense, plus an investment mark-to-market loss or an export-control inventory charge. This could push GAAP EPS to $1.00-1.15.
- **High:** Another large gain on long-term investments, or a tax benefit, on top of a strong revenue beat. This could push GAAP EPS to $1.80 or more.
